// Map each job to the sheet's columns. Score fields are filled in Phase 3.
const today = $now.setZone('Europe/London').toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: {
  job_id: i.json.job_id,
  date_found: today,
  source: i.json.source,
  title: i.json.title,
  company: i.json.company,
  location: i.json.location,
  salary: i.json.salary,
  url: i.json.url,
  score: i.json.score ?? '',
  matched_skills: (i.json.matched_skills ?? []).join(', '),
  missing_skills: (i.json.missing_skills ?? []).join(', '),
  reason: i.json.reason ?? '',
  status: 'New',
}}));
